Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a miscalculation error when computing the difference in layers between BERT base encoder and the encoder from "Attention is All You Need." Despite correctly identifying that BERT base has 12 layers and "Attention is All You Need" encoder has 6 layers, the Planner erroneously calculated the difference as 4 instead of 6. This error stems from a simple arithmetic mistake rather than any failure in verification of source information or retrieval of needed data.
